svg.text: Entity Relationship Diagram — Barangay Document System
composite build · MySQL 8.0 · database barangay_db · InnoDB · utf8mb4 · schema: Database/schema.sql
ux_requests_receipt — UNIQUE (official_receipt_no): unpaid rows stay NULL, so any number of unpaid requests can coexist.
ux_requests_jobseeker — UNIQUE (jobseeker_guard): generated column repeats resident_id while a first-time jobseeker request (type 5, not rejected) is live — one per resident, no trigger.
resident_snapshots freezes the resident's details as of request time (1 ∶ 1 with document_requests) — later profile edits never rewrite history.
scope carries the Citizen's Charter clearance pricing: 0 = local employment (PHP 100) · 1 = work abroad (PHP 200).
